      protected ScannerProperties()

    • store

      public int store(PropertyEditor to, boolean persist)
      Provides a way to store the properties through a PropertyEditor.
      Overrides:
      store in class PropertyGroup
      Parameters:
      to - PropertyEditor an editor used to load the current barcode families and properties.
      persist - boolean if the property must be persistent or not across reboots.
      Returns:
      int ConfigException.SUCCESSvin case of success, otherwise a possible error code, matching one of the ConfigException error constants.
      Throws:
      ConfigException - in case of error, when exceptions are enabled through the ErrorManager singleton.
